name: slidingbox-hydrate-dehydrate
description: Hand a secret to another agent as an encrypted token delivered exactly once, pre-flight an x402 endpoint, and check or watch whether a web page has changed.
long_description:
`store_secret` encrypts on your machine (AES-256-GCM) and returns one token. Whoever holds the token gets the secret exactly once — the first successful read delivers it and destroys it, and a second read returns nothing. Slidingbox stores only ciphertext: the decryption key travels in the token and is never sent to the server. That is why this runs locally over stdio rather than as a remote MCP server — a remote one would have to receive your plaintext in order to encrypt it.

`verify_endpoint` answers a different question: before your agent pays an unfamiliar x402 endpoint, is it reachable, does it present a valid payment challenge, and do its live price and payee still match what the CDP Bazaar catalog advertises. It returns a bounded JSON verdict with reason codes, and it never pays the endpoint under test.

`has_page_changed` and `watch_page` answer a third question: has this web page changed since it was last checked, by anyone? Every check of a URL is kept as hashes, so you learn what changed — status, redirect target, content type, which sections by position, and whether the set of scripts it loads changed — without the page itself ever being stored or returned. A page's first check is free and later ones cost $0.05; a 7-day watch with hourly checks and a signed callback on each change costs $0.50 once.

Storing is free. A read costs $0.02 and a verify costs $0.01, covered either by an issued evaluation key or by a Base wallet paying per call over x402 — no account, no invoice, no subscription. Secrets live 60–900 seconds and then expire. Not storage, backup, messaging, or key management.

tools.name: store_secret
tools.description: Encrypt a secret locally and store the ciphertext on Slidingbox. Returns one token carrying the pointer and the key.

tools.name: retrieve_secret
tools.description: Read a secret once, using the token from store_secret. The read destroys it.

tools.name: verify_endpoint
tools.description: Check whether an x402 endpoint is live, payable, and still priced as its catalog listing claims, before paying it.

tools.name: has_page_changed
tools.description: Check whether a web page has changed since it was last checked, by anyone: status, redirect, content type, sections, scripts. First check free.

tools.name: watch_page
tools.description: Watch a web page for 7 days with hourly checks and a signed callback on each change. One payment, ends by itself.

api_key.title: Evaluation key
api_key.description: An issued key (sbk_<id>.<hmac>) covering a fixed number of free reads. Get one instantly with: curl -X POST https://slidingbox.ai/v1/key Leave blank if paying by wallet.

private_key.title: Base wallet private key
private_key.description: A wallet holding USDC on Base, paying per call over x402: a read $0.02, a verify $0.01, a page-change check $0.05 (first check free), a watch $0.50. Use a wallet funded for this and nothing else. Leave blank if using an evaluation key.

base_url.title: Service URL
base_url.description: Leave as-is unless you were told otherwise.
